feeds.title: US Green Card Office Blog
feeds.description: The program is officially called the Electronic Diversity Immigrant Visa Program. Its objective is to issue Green Cards to individuals born in countries with historically low levels of immigration to the United States. The Visa Program was created by the Immigration Act of 1990 and signed into law by President George Bush.
